payload.text:
I would like you to build an application called CareLens. The main purpose of this application is to enhance the preventive care of its users. The application should have the following 3 features;
A) Feature 1. (Prevention Dashboard)

This feature should have the following sub features;
I)  Immunization & Vaccine dashboard.

This subfeature will hold a record of all the immunizations a user has had. It will be input by the user.
This subfeature will recommend personalized booster shots, follow ups or certain specific necessary immunizations/vaccines the user should get depending on either the area the user is in, the demography of the user, data from the user profile or perhaps an outbreak or trend as well as why that particular shot is needed (personalized education).
II) Preventive Screening dashboard.

This subfeature will include a list of all screenings taken.
This subfeature will notify the user, based on the screenings taken and the user profile data, when the next one(screening) should be taken (depending on how frequent it should be administered and personalized for the user) along with clear rationale as to why the said screening matters.
III) Avoidant Measures.

This subfeature would offer personalized Lifestyle Recommendations based on the profile of the User and their habits(lifestyle) e.g. minimizing smoking/cholestrol to lower the risk of getting...(personalized). The evidence-based tips should adjust with the user data present.

The recommendations from this sub feature should be adaptive to what they need specifically (demographics + lifestyle + medical history + risk scores + user profile data) and not generic.
B) Feature 2. (Analysis & Risk)

This feature should have the following sub features;
I) Symptom Diary.

This sub feature would allow a user to log in signs and symptoms they may have and also displays previously logged in signs and symptoms (along with frequency, duration and severity).
Once the user has logged in their symptoms and signs, the system would suggest personalized measures to deal with them (with an appropriate disclaimer).
II) Risk Calculators.

This sub feature, coupled with red flag traige, would offer smart tests and screening suggestions (with an appropriate diclaimer accompanying it).
Using the data from the Symptom Diary (as well as recurring symptoms and signs) and based mostly on an individual's risks, demography, medical & family history, user profile data and anything else present , the AI in the system (gemini 3) would analyze and recommend particular tests and screenings that should be done as well as why it may be necessary (this should be personalized), what it is, how it is done, where to go to get it done(closest medical facility that offers it), what it is for and what it is diagnosing.
C) Feature 3. (Management & Care)

This feature should have the following sub features;
I) Disease-Specific Management/Care Plans.

This sub feature would offer tailored management recommendations and adaptive guidance that would be fully focused on the conditions the user has or had. This would be inputted by the user.
The education modules in this sub feature would be personalized and would explain how to handle certain issues and situations, they would also include emerging info on the same (depending on the conditions previously had or currently have), they would give suggestions on what habits to adopt and personalized actions and info to help manage the condition and why to do so e.g. Exercise by walking/jogging 5KM/day...
II) Progress Tracking.

This sub feature would keep a record of how the user is fairing through the use of user-friendly manual user inputs that would be able to tell things such as whether they've got a high blood pressure (this would be gotten from the doctor's review but inputted by the user).
The information gotten from this sub feature would be used all through CareLens to enable better personalization of the services offered.

The User Profile would include their basic information which is their name, gender, age(DOB), location, email. Their health background which includes current conditions, allergies, current medication, family history, organ donor status. And finally their Lifestyle data which includes their dietary preference, physical activity (type, duration, frequency which would be indicated in a weekly format), sleep patterns and substance use.
For the homepage UI/UX, I would like the background to be a seemingly realistic 3D geode cave which would be deep Midnight Blue (#0B1026) grading into rich Charcoal (#121212) filled with 3D rendering of shiny geodes and clusters of crystals which would have the following intense and rich colours; Sapphire Blue to Ultraviolet (#2D5BFF to #8C52FF), Amethyst Purple to Magenta (#9D46FF to #FF0099) and Emerald Green to Teal (#00FF94 to #00BCD4). The homepage would have a pulsing geometric crystal artifact which would be floating at the centre while glowing bright cyan. This crystal artifact would have an indicator "👤" showing that it leads to the user profile when clicked. When the user hovers over it, beneath the crystal artifact should display "User Profile" to indicate that clicking it would lead to the user profile page. In the homepage there will also be other 3 floating crystal prism shards around the main crystal artifact. These 3 crystal prism shards would represent the three features of CareLens and similar to the main crystal artifact, each one would lead to a specific page when clicked in accordance to the feature it represents while also maintaining the same pulsing glow and hover effect corresponding with their respective colors. The first shard would be the "Prevention Dashboard" which would lead to the same page when clicked and would display the same name beneath it when the hover effect is activated on it. The indicator within the shard would be "🛡️" while the color of the shard would be a harmonious blend of Sapphire Blue to Ultraviolet (#2D5BFF to #8C52FF). The second shard would be the "Analysis & Risk" which would lead to the same page when clicked and would display the same name beneath it when the hover effect is activated on it. The indicator within the shard would be "💎" while the color of the shard would be a harmonious blend of Amethyst Purple to Magenta (#9D46FF to #FF0099). The first shard would be the "Management & Care" which would lead to the same page when clicked and would display the same name beneath it when the hover effect is activated on it. The indicator within the shard would be "🪴" while the color of the shard would be a harmonious blend of Emerald Green to Teal (#00FF94 to #00BCD4). The main difference between the prism crystal shards, crystal artifact and the shiny geodes and clusters of crystals in the background is that the shards and crystal artifact would have a pulsing neon glow with their respective colors while the shiny geodes and crystals in the background would be 3D rendered geometric. This should be clear in order to enable the user differentiate between them. For the pages (User Profile, Prevention Dashboard, Analysis & Risk and Management & Care), when opened the pages would be displayed on top of the homepage background but with a glassmorphism effect meaning the homepage would only be slightly and mildy visible (20-30% opacity) to avoid distracting the user. There should also be a high gloss glass UI effect lining the edges for all the tabs and buttons in the pages that are analogous with the color scheme meaning in the user profile page the linings should be bright cyan, for the Prevention Dashboard page the linings should be a blend of Sapphire Blue to Ultraviolet, for the Analysis & Risk page the linings should be a blend of Amethyst Purple to Magenta and for the Management & Care page the linings should be a blend of Emerald Green to Teal.

**Considering the App's Purpose**

I'm now fully immersed in the project's core purpose. The name "CareLens" immediately evokes a vision. I am focusing on the implications of preventive care enhancement. I'm exploring how the suggested technologies can be leveraged to achieve this goal, with a particular focus on user experience.

I am also currently working on the application's folder and file structure, including the core components and services like the Gemini API integration. I'm prioritizing data models and component reusability.


**Building the Geode Aesthetic**

I'm now implementing the "Geode Cave" theme. I'm focusing on creating the 2.5D visual effects with CSS transforms and gradients, since external 3D libraries will not be used. I've begun working on the floating crystal nodes for the homepage navigation, to provide an immersive experience. I'm prioritizing the UI/UX with the goal of creating an intuitive and visually engaging design. I've finalized the feature components.


**Developing Visual Elements**

I'm now implementing the crystal design. I'm focusing on the background's deep radial gradient and the static crystals using CSS shapes with low opacity, creating a subtle, immersive feel. For the interactive crystals, I'm defining the colors and animations, with central cyan glow and gradients for different features. **Outlining Core Application Files**

I am now focusing on the application's file structure, implementing the core components and services. I've defined interfaces in `types.ts` and set up the Gemini API integration in `geminiService.ts`, implementing the `getGeminiResponse` and `analyzeRisk` methods. The `App.tsx` file is ready to serve as the main stage. I am now working on using `gemini-3-flash-preview` for general text and `gemini-3-pro-preview` for complex risk analysis.


**Polishing the Implementation**

I'm now fully immersed in the final refinements. Based on the code structure and features implemented, here is the technical stack and a description of how CareLens was built.

### **Tech Stack**

**Frontend Core:**
*   **Framework:** React 19 (Functional Components & Hooks)
*   **Language:** TypeScript (Strict typing for robust data handling)
*   **Styling:** Tailwind CSS (Utility-first styling) + Custom CSS (Complex 3D animations and glassmorphism)
*   **Module Loading:** ES Modules via CDN (`esm.sh`) using Import Maps (No complex bundler required for this iteration)

**AI & Intelligence:**
*   **LLM Provider:** Google Gemini API (via `@google/genai` SDK)
*   **Models Used:**
    *   `gemini-3-flash-preview` (Fast inference for general recommendations and plans)
    *   `gemini-3-pro-preview` (Complex reasoning for risk analysis and symptom checking)
*   **Prompt Engineering:** Context-aware prompts injecting user profile data for personalized outputs.

**Libraries & Tools:**
*   **Visualization:** Recharts (For health progress line and area charts)
*   **Icons:** Lucide React (Consistent, scalable UI icons)
*   **Formatting:** React Markdown (To render structured AI advice with headers and lists)

**Data & State:**
*   **State Management:** React `useState` / `useEffect` (Client-side in-memory state for the MVP)
*   **Persistence:** Currently ephemeral (session-based); ready for integration with backend databases like Firebase or PostgreSQL.

### **How It Was Built**

CareLens was architected as a **Single Page Application (SPA)** with a heavy focus on immersive UI and personalized AI integration.

1.  **3D Ambient Interface:**
    The foundation is a custom-built 3D parallax environment. It uses CSS `keyframes` and `transform: translateZ` to create a "Geode Cave" aesthetic. The crystal elements are generated algorithmically in React (`useMemo`) to create a unique, floating background that reacts to mouse movement without impacting the scroll performance of the foreground content.

2.  **Modular Feature Architecture:**
    The application is divided into distinct functional nodes:
    *   **Profile Engine:** Captures demographic and lifestyle data which serves as the "context context" for all AI operations.
    *   **Dashboarding:** Uses specific sub-components (`PreventionDashboard`, `AnalysisRisk`, `ManagementCare`) that are rendered conditionally within a reusable `GlassModal` wrapper. This ensures a consistent "glass" aesthetic while keeping logic separated.

3.  **Context-Aware AI Integration:**
    Instead of generic chat bots, the app uses a dedicated service layer (`geminiService.ts`). This layer acts as an orchestrator:
    *   It takes raw user input (symptoms, age, location).
    *   It constructs structured prompts that define the AI's persona ("CareLens, a warm health partner").
    *   It specifies formatting requirements (Markdown) and mandatory safety disclaimers.
    *   It selects the appropriate model (Flash for speed, Pro for deep analysis) based on the complexity of the task.

4.  **Responsive & Interactive Design:**
    Tailwind CSS was used to rapidly build responsive grids that stack on mobile and expand on desktop. Visual feedback (hover states, pulsing glows, loading spinners) was implemented to ensure the user feels "connected" to the system, making the AI interactions feel live and responsive rather than static.
